ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: An automated drilling and riveting machine can install dozens of rivets in a minute, but assemblers still judge the loads at that location, the fit of the skin panel, and the final quality signoff.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 33,600 Aircraft Structure, Surfaces, Rigging, And Systems Assemblers employed in 2024, falling to a projected 28,700 by 2034. That is a net decline of roughly 4,900 jobs, with about 2,800 openings each year and a 2026 median annual wage near $61,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI is changing aircraft assembly through human-machine collaboration, not fully unmanned production. Automated drilling and riveting, robotic assembly, and digital measurement take over repetitive stations, while assemblers shift toward process setup, exception handling, and final quality confirmation. Aviation assembly assigns signed accountability: automation performs the work, while people accept responsibility. Fully unmanned assembly remains unlikely in the foreseeable future.
ai_s2_accel: AI vision assists riveting and surface quality inspection
Augmented reality (AR) assembly guidance replaces paper drawings
Digital twin assembly simulations reveal interference in advance
Automated tightening systems record torque data for every bolt
ai_s2_auto: Automated drilling and riveting of repetitive fuselage skin joints
Robotic assembly stations perform standard fastening operations
Laser projection guides assembly positioning instead of manual marking
Digital measurement automatically generates tolerance inspection reports
ai_s3_list: Tolerance and fit judgment: assess structural loads that machines cannot capture.
Exception handling: make on-site decisions about interference, misalignment, and material defects.
Control system setup: tune cable tension and travel by feel.
Quality responsibility: each signature reflects judgment about whole-aircraft safety.
Process collaboration: resolve issues with manufacturing engineering, quality, and design teams.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score places this career where automation is advancing but cannot fully replace people. Machines take over repetitive riveting and assembly, while people remain essential for process setup, exception handling, and signed quality approval. Assemblers now combine hands-on work, setup, and quality control.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate risk still brings substantial change. People who operate automated drilling and riveting equipment, interpret digital measurement data, and resolve assembly exceptions are advancing from operators to technicians. Purely manual stations will decline, while assembly technicians who collaborate with machines become scarcer.

ai_s5_persona.建议: For an aviation manufacturing career, prioritize aviation manufacturing, mechanical engineering, or mechatronics and seek internships at aircraft manufacturers. Treat digital measurement, automated drilling and riveting, and assembly processes as required skills rather than practicing only manual riveting.

Request retraining for automated stations and learn automated drilling and riveting, digital measurement, and AR assembly guidance. Advance toward assembly technician, manufacturing specialist, or team leader roles while preserving manual skills for exception handling.

People with mechanical assembly, sheet metal, or mechatronics backgrounds can transition relatively smoothly. Earn aviation assembly and safety qualifications, then start on a supplier assembly line. Strong tolerance awareness and quality-record habits can impress employers more than certificates alone.

During automation investment, do not cut assembler staffing indiscriminately. Use people for setup and quality control. Create parallel advancement paths for automation equipment operation and process expertise so experienced assemblers can lead new stations.

Overlays virtual assembly steps and information
Detects assembly interference and conflicts in advance
Records torque data for every bolt
ai_s6_tools.工具: Automated tightening and torque recording system

ai_s7_trends: Automated drilling, riveting, and robotic assembly are expanding, reducing purely manual assembly stations.
Assemblers are shifting toward automated equipment operation + process setup + quality control.
Digital and AR assembly guidance is becoming standard on final assembly lines.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动钻铆机一分钟能打几十颗铆钉，但「这个部位的受力、这块蒙皮的配合」以及最终的质量签字，责任还是落在装配工手上。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年飞机结构、表面、索具、系统装配工在岗约 3.36 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.87 万人，岗位净减约 0.49 万个，年均产生约 0.28 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.17 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 正在改变飞机装配，但方向是「人机协作」而不是「无人化」：自动钻铆机、机器人装配和数字化测量接管了重复性工位，装配工转向工艺调试、异常处理和最终质量确认。航空装配的签字责任制决定了——自动化负责「干活」，人负责「负责」。完全无人装配在可预见的未来很难实现。
ai_s2_accel: AI 视觉检测辅助铆接与表面质量复核
增强现实（AR）装配指导替代纸质图纸
数字孪生装配仿真提前暴露干涉问题
自动拧紧系统记录每颗螺栓力矩数据
ai_s2_auto: 自动钻铆机完成机身蒙皮重复铆接
机器人装配工作站执行标准紧固作业
激光投影引导装配定位替代手工划线
数字化测量自动生成公差检测报告
ai_s3_list: 公差与配合判断：机器测不出的受力合理性。
异常处置：干涉、错位、材料缺陷的现场决策。
操纵系统调试：钢索张力与行程的手感调校。
质量责任：签字背后对整机安全的判断。
工艺协作：跟工艺、质检、设计把问题闭环。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处于「自动化渗透但不可完全替代」的位置：重复性铆接装配被机器接管，但工艺调试、异常处理和质量签字仍高度依赖人。装配工的价值从「动手」转向「动手 + 调试 + 把关」。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中风险不等于没变化：能操作自动钻铆设备、看得懂数字化测量数据、能处理装配异常的人，正从操作工变成技术员。纯手工装配的工位会减少，会跟机器协作的装配技师反而更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想进航空制造，优先选航空制造、机械工程、机电一体化专业，尽量去主机厂实习。把数字化测量、自动钻铆和装配工艺当必修课，别只练手工铆接。
主动申请自动化工位的转岗培训，把自动钻铆、数字测量、AR 装配指导学起来。往装配技师、工艺员或班组长发展，手工功底保留住用于异常处置。
有机械装配、钣金或机电背景的转行相对顺：先考取航空装配资质和安全认证，从供应商装配线做起。简历突出你的公差意识和质量记录习惯，比证书更打动人。
自动化投入期别压缩装配工编制，把人力用在「调试 + 把关」上。建立自动化设备操作与工艺能力的双轨晋升，让老装配工转型成新工位的骨干。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can organize evidence chains, precedents, and statutes faster than people, but a human still has to bring angry parties back to the table.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 9,100 arbitrators, mediators, and conciliators were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 9,500 by 2034, a net gain of about 400 jobs, with roughly 300 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $67,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace arbitrators and mediators, but it will reshape administrative work. AI can organize evidence, research precedents, and draft decisions. Dispute resolution depends on human communication and judgment: calming emotions, finding common ground, and helping parties accept an outcome. AI cannot perform these duties or carry the responsibility of earning trust in a result.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted issue prediction and dispute classification
Wider use of online mediation and remote hearings
Automated case progress and deadline management
ai_s2_auto: Electronic organization of case files and evidence
Drafting arbitration awards and mediation agreements
ai_s3_list: Emotional control: calm parties who have lost control.
Reading between the lines: identify each party's unstated limits.
Neutrality: remain impartial and earn acceptance from all parties.
Creative solutions: find an acceptable path out of an impasse.
Procedural authority: maintain order and control the process.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score places dispute resolution in the moderate AI exposure range for knowledge work. AI can substantially improve document drafting, research, and recordkeeping, while mediation and adjudication remain person-to-person work. The score also signals that arbitrators who use AI can handle more cases, while career paths based only on desk research will narrow.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure is not a crisis. Court caseloads are growing, court-connected mediation is expanding, and demand for professional mediators is rising. Give document and research work to AI, then invest the saved time in industry expertise such as construction, finance, or intellectual property and in a strong mediation reputation. That combination improves negotiating power.

ai_s5_persona.建议: A law degree provides the foundation for this path, supported by psychology or an industry field such as finance or engineering. Pass the legal qualification exam, then build practical experience in legal practice or an in-house role. Arbitration and mediation reward experience over time, so do not expect immediate seniority.

Develop deep expertise in a field such as employment, commercial, family, or intellectual property disputes. Earn arbitrator credentials or join a mediation roster. Use AI for document and legal research, while focusing personal effort on mediation technique and industry knowledge. Professional reputation generates case referrals.

Lawyers, in-house counsel, and HR professionals have useful experience for this transition, especially in employment and family mediation. Start in a mediator role at an arbitration organization to build case volume. In interviews, explain disputes you successfully resolved rather than listing credentials.

Arbitration and mediation organizations should create a clear mediator → arbitrator → presiding arbitrator progression, make case-based compensation transparent, and provide AI drafting and research tools. This lets specialists spend their time on mediation and decisions.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Instant access to similar cases and statutory provisions
Draft arbitration awards and mediation agreements
Automated conversion of hearing audio to text
Audit trail for electronic evidence chains

ai_s7_trends: Court-connected mediation and diversified dispute resolution are expanding, increasing demand for mediators.
Online hearings and electronic arbitration are becoming widespread and substantially improving case efficiency.
Commercial and international arbitration specialists are in demand, with deeper specialization as the main direction.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把证据链、判例和条文整理得比人快，但「让两个拍桌子的人坐下来谈」这件事，还得有个活人在场。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年仲裁员、调解员与和解员在岗约 0.91 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.95 万人，净增约 0.04 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.03 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.77 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代仲裁员与调解员，但会重塑文职环节：证据整理、判例检索、裁决书初稿都能由 AI 完成。争议解决的本质是人对人的沟通与判断——安抚情绪、寻找共识、让双方接受结果，这些 AI 做不了，也承担不了「让人信服」的责任。
ai_s2_accel: AI 争议焦点预判与分类
调解方案可行性分析辅助
在线调解与远程听证普及
案件进度与期限智能管理
ai_s2_auto: 卷宗与证据电子化整理
裁决书与调解书初稿生成
ai_s3_list: 情绪把控：让失控的当事人冷静下来。
弦外之音：听出双方没明说的底线。
中立立场：不偏不倚让双方都服气。
方案创造力：给僵局一个都能下的台阶。
程序权威：压得住场、镇得住程序。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明争议解决属于「中等 AI 曝光」的知识型岗位：文书、检索、记录这些环节 AI 能大幅提效，但核心的调解与裁断是「人对人」的工作。中位评分也提醒：会用 AI 提速的仲裁员能接更多案子，纯靠案头功夫熬资历的路会变窄。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于危机：法院案件量在涨、诉调对接在推开，专业调解员的需求在上升。把文书和检索交给 AI，把省下的时间用在钻研行业（比如建工、金融、知产）和积累调解口碑上，议价能力反而更强。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想走这条路的，法学本科是基础，建议辅修心理学或行业方向（金融、工程等）。先过法考、再做几年律师或法务攒实务，仲裁调解是「越老越值钱」的慢职业，别指望一步登天。
深耕一个专业领域（劳动、商事、家事、知产），考取仲裁员资格或加入调解名册；用 AI 处理文书检索，把精力放在调解技巧和行业理解上，专业口碑就是案源。
律师、法务、HR 从业者转型有优势，尤其是劳动争议和家事调解方向。可以先从仲裁机构的调解员岗位切入，积累案件量；面试时讲清楚你成功化解过的纠纷，比罗列证书有用。
仲裁与调解机构要留住专业人才，建议打通「调解员—仲裁员—首席」晋升通道，按案计酬透明化，并给团队配 AI 文书与检索工具，让专业人才把时间花在调解和裁决本身。

ai_s7_trends: 诉调对接与多元解纷机制扩张，调解需求上升。
在线听证与电子仲裁普及，办案效率大幅提升。
商事仲裁与国际仲裁人才走俏，专业化是主线。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Computer Network Architects, but it will reshape their workflows. Tools take over repetitive and structured work, while people focus on judgment, accountability, and original problem-solving. Formulaic execution faces pressure, while professionals who apply expertise to real network environments and make sound decisions become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Use network telemetry and traffic profiles to assess operational needs faster.
Use simulation and scenario testing to evaluate network design options faster.
Use retrieval tools to verify technical documentation and standards.
Use collaboration tools to accelerate coordination across infrastructure, security, and application teams.
ai_s2_auto: Automated generation of structured network architecture documents and reports.
Repetitive network data processing and classification.
Rule-based initial network checks and implementation scheduling.
Network architecture knowledge-base search and key-point extraction.
ai_s3_list: Professional judgment and tradeoffs in real network architecture scenarios.
The ability to explain network architecture to nontechnical stakeholders.
Accountability and final review for network architecture decisions.
Cross-functional resource integration and interpersonal coordination for network projects.
Reuse of tacit knowledge from long experience in network architecture.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 8/10 places this career in the relatively high exposure range. AI can assist network analysis, documentation, simulation, and configuration review, but professional judgment and final accountability remain difficult to replace.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Turn 8/10 into an advantage: let AI take the repetitive work, and spend your time on real projects, judgment, and people.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strong network architecture fundamentals and gain experience on real projects.
Connect existing infrastructure, security, or systems experience to network architecture and identify a differentiated entry point.
Turn network architecture experience into reusable platforms or management systems to increase leverage.
Use AI to reduce repetitive network work and focus on architecture decisions.

ai_s7_trends: Network architecture and AI collaboration become standard, making tool fluency an entry requirement.

Network architecture roles combine deeper technical expertise with management and product skills.

body: Computer Network Architects design enterprise local area networks, wide area networks, and cloud network structures. They determine how data moves and where defenses are placed, and they are responsible for network performance and security.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can run vast searches for factors, but a quant still has to explain why a signal should earn returns.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), employment of Financial Quantitative Analysts is projected to rise from about 137,100 in 2024 to 141,400 in 2034. That is a net increase of about 4,300 jobs, with roughly 10,300 openings each year. The median annual wage is about $80,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Financial Quantitative Analysts; it is becoming integral to their work. Machine learning accelerates factor discovery and backtesting, while people still set models, prevent overfitting, and create strategies. Professionals who understand both markets and models and turn theory into stable returns remain scarce.
ai_s2_auto: Automated cleaning of market and alternative data
Batch searches for factor discovery and backtesting
ai_s3_list: Model design: choose methods and prevent overfitting.
Market understanding: explain why a signal works.
Risk judgment: plan for extreme markets.
Strategy creation: find angles others have missed.
Final accountability: sign off on model results.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this career in the moderate-high exposure range for financial data work. Systems accelerate cleaning, searching, and reporting, while people still own modeling and judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high career risk. Automation replaces running processes and reporting, not model design and strategy creation. Quants who set models, understand markets, and detect failure become scarcer. Entry-level roles limited to data cleaning face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in mathematics, computer science, or financial engineering, and practice programming and machine learning early. The AI era rewards integration of models with market understanding, not theory alone.
Master machine learning and alternative data, and strengthen your market knowledge. Move from research to strategy ownership. Preventing overfitting is essential.
Show which models you built and how they performed historically. Backtesting and live-trading results carry the most weight.
Hire for mathematical depth and market judgment, not credentials alone. Quants who independently manage strategies merit strong compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Alternative data and machine learning are becoming standard.
Risk management and portfolio optimization are becoming more intelligent.
Hybrid quants who understand both markets and models are scarcer.

body: Financial Quantitative Analysts use statistics, machine learning, and numerical methods for asset pricing, risk modeling, and trading-strategy research and backtesting. They turn financial theory into executable quantitative models.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can run vast searches for factors, but a quant still has to explain why a signal should earn returns.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把因子挖掘跑成百万次搜索，但「这个信号为什么能赚钱」，还得 quant 想明白。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年金融分析师在岗约 13.71 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 14.14 万人，净增约 0.43 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.03 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.02 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代量化分析师，反而深度绑定。机器学习加速因子挖掘和回测，但模型设定、过拟合防范和策略创造仍靠人。真正稀缺的是既懂市场又懂模型、能把理论变成稳定收益的人。
ai_s2_accel: 机器学习辅助信号发现
研究报告的自然语言生成
ai_s2_auto: 行情与另类数据的自动清洗
因子挖掘与回测的批量搜索
风险指标的自动计算与报表
ai_s3_list: 模型设定：用什么方法、防过拟合。
市场理解：信号为何有效。
风险判断：极端行情怎么办。
策略创造：别人没挖的角度。
责任兜底：模型签字担责。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的金融数据区——清洗、搜索、报表都能被加速，但建模和判断仍留给人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「跑和报」，不是「设和创」。会定模型、懂市场、能防失效的 quant 更稀缺。怕的是只做数据清洗的初级岗。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 数学计算机金工打底，早练编程与机器学习。AI 时代拼模型与市场的结合，别只学理论。
把 ML 和另类数据用熟，补市场常识。从「做研究」升级成「管策略」，抗过拟合能力是关键。
突出你做过什么模型、历史表现如何。有回测和实盘成果优先。
招人看数学深度和市场感，不止看学历。能独立管策略的 quant 值得高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 另类数据与机器学习成标配。
风控与组合优化智能化。
会市场又懂模型的复合 quant 更稀缺。

career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能把因子挖掘跑成百万次搜索，但「这个信号为什么能赚钱」，还得 quant 想明白。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Software can calculate layout positions, but helpers still determine how to hand over, support, and coordinate on site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 45,300 helpers to pipelayers, plumbers, pipefitters, and steamfitters employed in 2024, projected to reach 47,500 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 2,200 jobs, with roughly 4,900 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $39,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace pipe-trade helpers, but it will reduce layout work. Positioning and cutting software accelerates planning, shifting work from measurement toward field coordination, physical execution, and learning the trade. Workers who only hand over materials face pressure, while those who coordinate and learn become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Field coordination: people connect the work.
Physical execution: people provide hands and feet.
Learning the trade: people teach practical feel.
Safety control: people provide awareness.
Process coordination: people make teamwork work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score places this occupation in a low-moderate exposure range. Layout and cutting accelerate, but coordination and physical work still depend on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still brings change. Pure material handoff faces replacement, not work based on coordination and learning. Infrastructure makes adaptable learners scarcer, while workers limited to handing over supplies face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Starting as a general laborer, practice coordination and learn the trade. Pure material handoff is shrinking in the AI era, so develop craft skills early.
Advance from handing over materials to coordinating and learning pipe work, including layout software.
Emphasize willingness to learn and physical ability, and specify the trades you have supported.
Do not select workers only for strength; evaluate their ability to coordinate and learn. Strong core workers merit mentoring.

ai_s7_trends: Digital layout.
Infrastructure sustains demand.
Workers who learn the trade are more competitive.

body: Pipe-trade helpers assist with laying water, gas, and steam lines. They hand over materials, steady components, excavate and clean, and support connections so pipeline construction proceeds safely and smoothly.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Software can calculate layout positions, but helpers still determine how to hand over, support, and coordinate on site.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代管工帮工，但会压缩放线环节。定位与下料软件把排版提速，工作从「量位」挪向「现场配合、体力执行、学艺成长」。真正被挤掉的是只递料的人，会配合会学的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 现场配合：接活靠人。

安全把关：意识靠人。
工序协调：配合靠人。

基建维持需求。
会学艺更抢手。

career_ai_description_block.heading: 放线能算位，但怎么递、怎么扶、现场怎么配，还是帮工定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Generative design can automatically produce concepts, but engineers still decide which constraints to preserve, how to balance service life against cost, and how to modify designs on site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 293,100 mechanical engineers were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 319,600 by 2034. That represents roughly 26,500 additional jobs and about 18,100 openings per year, with median annual pay of approximately $102,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace mechanical engineers, but it will accelerate routine design. CAD and generative design speed up standard modeling, shifting engineers from drawing standard parts toward system tradeoffs, cross-disciplinary coordination, on-site judgment, and reliability assurance. People limited to standard drawings face the greatest pressure, while engineers with systems capabilities become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: System tradeoffs: people make the choices.
Cross-disciplinary coordination: people manage interfaces.
Field judgment: people investigate anomalies.
Reliability assurance: people carry responsibility.
Requirements translation: people understand the pain points.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 score places this occupation in a moderately high-exposure engineering area. Systems accelerate routine modeling, while systems work and on-site decisions still depend on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Producing standard drawings is the activity being replaced, not systems-design roles. Engineers with systems capabilities who coordinate on-site work become scarcer as productivity rises. Those limited to drawing from templates face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a mechanical-engineering foundation and practice simulation and projects. Pure drafting volume is shrinking in the AI era, so develop systems thinking early.
Advance from producing standard drawings toward systems work and long-term on-site ownership. Learn simulation and data analysis and seek responsibility for complete systems.
Highlight project and on-site experience, and specify the industries you have worked in. Employers value stability and specialization.
Do not assess candidates only on software skills; look for systems thinking. Core professionals who coordinate effectively deserve higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Generative design becomes widespread, reducing standard roles.
New energy and robotics create opportunities.
People with systems capabilities become more sought after.

body: Mechanical engineers lead the design and development of mechanical systems and equipment. They coordinate structures, materials, and processes and use modeling, simulation, and testing to create manufacturable products that meet performance and cost requirements.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Generative design can automatically produce concepts, but engineers still decide which constraints to preserve, how to balance service life against cost, and how to modify designs on site.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代机械工程师，但会加速常规设计。CAD 与生成式设计把标准建模提速，工程师从画标准件挪向系统权衡、跨专业协调、现场判断与可靠性把关。真正被挤掉的是只画标准图的，有系统力的人更值钱。

可靠性把关：责任靠人。
需求转化：痛点靠人。

新能源与机器人带来机会。
有系统力的人更抢手。

Customer explanations: people provide the communication.

Prototype makers skilled in fitting are more sought after.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Interlocking systems can set routes automatically, but experienced workers' hands and eyes still handle field emergencies, manual verification, and emergency response.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 11,000 railroad, signal, and operating workers were employed in 2024, projected to rise to 11,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 100 jobs, with about 1,000 openings annually and median annual pay of about $65,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace this occupation, but it will reduce entry-level roles. Computer interlocking and automated switching accelerate routine operations, shifting people from manually throwing switches toward monitoring, inspection, emergency response, and dispatch coordination. Pure repetitive switch-throwing is replaced, while people who understand equipment and respond to emergencies are more secure.
ai_s3_list: Field emergency response: people decide what to do.
Equipment assessment: people listen for unusual sounds.
Safety verification: people bear responsibility.
Complex operations: people build experience.
Coordinated commands: people verify communication.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 indicates that this occupation has moderately high exposure in field operations: equipment automation replaces physical actions, but safety verification and emergency response still leave a clear role for people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk: purely manual switch throwing is replaced, not safety-gatekeeping roles. People with equipment knowledge who handle emergencies become scarcer as automation spreads. Those limited to repetitive switch throwing without understanding equipment face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Follow a railway-school or targeted-training path and earn signal/brake qualifications early. Purely physical roles are shrinking in the AI era.
Advance from manual operation to equipment knowledge + emergency response, and learn interlocking and inspection systems.
Highlight certifications and rotating-shift experience. Railways place greater weight on reliability and safety records.
Do not hire based only on physical strength. Look for safety awareness and emergency judgment, and provide stability in safety-critical roles.

ai_s7_trends: Interlocking automation reduces entry-level roles.
Intelligent inspection supplements human safeguards.
People who understand equipment and handle emergencies are in greater demand.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 联锁系统能自动排进路，但现场突发、人工确认和应急，还是靠这拨老师傅的手和眼。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代这一行，但会压缩基础岗。计算机联锁和自动调车把常规操作提速，人从「手动扳道」挪向「监控、巡检、应急和调度配合」。真正被替的是纯重复扳道动作，懂设备会应急的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 现场应急：突发靠人断。
设备判断：异响靠人听。
安全确认：责任靠人担。
复杂作业：经验靠人攒。
协同口令：沟通靠人对。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的现场操作区——设备自动化在替动作，但安全确认和应急还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「纯手动扳道」动作，不是「安全守门」的岗位。有设备知识、能应急的人，反而随自动化更稀缺。怕的是只会重复扳道、不懂设备的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走铁路院校或定向培养，早考信号/制动资格，AI 时代纯体力岗在缩。
从手动操作升级成「会设备、能应急」，学联锁和巡检系统。
突出资格证和倒班经验，铁路更看稳和安全记录。

ai_s7_trends: 联锁自动化，基础岗缩。
智能巡检补人防。
懂设备会应急更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace recreation workers, but it will reshape their workflows. Tools handle repetitive and structured tasks while people focus on judgment, responsibility, and creativity. Rote execution roles face displacement, while people who understand real situations and make decisions become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Use data profiles to accelerate participant or learner assessment in recreation programs.
Use simulations and scenario exercises to accelerate recreation program planning.
Use retrieval tools to verify recreation materials and regulations.
Use collaboration tools to accelerate cross-team coordination in recreation work.
ai_s2_auto: Automatically generate structured documents and reports related to recreation work.
Process and classify repetitive recreation work data.
Perform rules-based preliminary screening and scheduling for recreation programs.
Search recreation work knowledge bases and extract key points.
ai_s3_list: Professional judgment and tradeoffs in real recreation settings.
The ability to explain recreation expertise to non-specialists.
Accountability and final review in recreation work.
Cross-boundary resource integration and interpersonal coordination in recreation work.
Reuse of tacit knowledge from long-term recreation experience.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Turn 4/10 into an advantage: let AI take the repetitive work, and spend your time on real projects, judgment, and people.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strong recreation work fundamentals first and gain experience on real programs.
Connect existing experience to recreation work and find a differentiated entry point.
Turn recreation experience into products or management systems to increase leverage.
Use AI to eliminate repetitive recreation work and focus on decisions.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代休闲活动从业人员，但会重塑Recreation Workers的作业流：把重复与可结构化任务交给工具，人聚焦判断、责任与创造。真正被挤掉的是照本宣科式执行，会结合真实场景、会决策的人更值钱。

Recreation Workers领域的责任承担与终审。
跨边界的Recreation Workers资源整合与人际协调。
Recreation Workers长期经验的隐性知识复用。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 把 4/10 变成优势：用 AI 解放重复劳动，把时间花在真实项目、判断与人际上。

用 AI 解放Recreation Workers重复劳动，聚焦决策。

ai_s3_list: Hazardous-waste identification: people judge risk.
Mixed-material handling: people determine appropriate use.
Equipment operation: people keep systems stable.
On-site emergency response: people handle unexpected events.
Material identification: people provide experience.

Hazardous-waste handling creates opportunities.
Workers with equipment skills are more sought after.

Highlight the garment types you have made and describe complex cases.

跨域协同：边界靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 8/10 说明电信工程专家处于高 AI 曝光区——常规监控与调参被加速，但规划与割接还留人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是重复巡检，不是网络规划与割接决策。怕的是只盯告警、不懂规划的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 通信底子打牢，早学协议与网优，AI 时代纯巡检在缩。
从「盯告警」升级成「做规划 + 割接」，学容量与根因。
突出规划与零事故记录，写明管过哪些区域。
选人看规划与故障功力，别只看会配哪台设备。

ai_s7_trends: 自智网络吃运维。
5G 专网需求升。
算力网络机会多。

career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动调参和巡检，但哪条链路该扩容、怎么割接零事故、容量怎么算，还是专家定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can use drones to identify dead branches and hazards, but the arborist in the tree still decides whether to cut a branch and which way it should fall.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 60,100 tree trimmers and pruners were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 62,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,000 jobs, with approximately 7,400 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $50,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace tree trimmers and pruners. Pruning is inherently on-site work at height, and climbing, cutting, and controlling fall direction all depend on human coordination and experience. Robotics pilots cover only a very small number of simple scenarios. AI can help with drone inspections, scheduling, and hazard records, identifying where work is needed more accurately, but people still determine how to prune.
ai_s2_accel: Drone inspection of dead branches and disease
Remote monitoring of work near energized lines
ai_s2_auto: Pruning work orders and scheduling systems
ai_s3_list: Cutting decisions: accurately determine which branch to cut and where it will fall.
Coordination at height: work steadily while climbing or using an aerial lift.
Tree knowledge: understand species, seasons, and pruning times.
Hazard identification: maintain safe clearance from lines and buildings.
Emergency response: handle broken branches and jammed saws on site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 rating means tree trimming has moderately high exposure as outdoor work. People perform the core tasks at height and on site, while AI only assists with inspections, scheduling, and records. The pruning itself cannot be replaced soon.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Do not overlook moderately high exposure. Drone inspections are already taking over some hazard identification work. Specialize in high-risk, high-skill areas such as large-tree pruning and work near energized lines, and build credentials and a strong reputation to become far more valuable than an ordinary trimmer.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Young people entering the field should first build physical fitness, and comfort with heights is essential. Either study landscaping or learn as an apprentice, with a focus on earning an aerial work certificate and making safe habits automatic.

Specialize in large-tree pruning and work near energized lines and earn the relevant credentials. Learn to use drone inspections and tree management apps so one person can manage more areas and substantially increase earnings.

Grounds maintenance and general landscaping workers have an advantage when moving into tree trimming. Add climbing and chainsaw skills, earn an aerial work certificate, and emphasize comfort with heights, endurance, and strong safety awareness in interviews.

Tree trimmers are difficult to recruit and retain. Use certification allowances, complete safety equipment, and hazard overtime pay to keep employees. Drone inspections can reduce patrol workloads and concentrate experienced workers on high-risk jobs.

ai_s6_tools.工具: Safety ropes and fall protection equipment

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Aerial detection of dead branches and disease

ai_s7_trends: As urban tree safety management tightens, demand is rising for large-tree pruning and work near energized lines.
Drone inspections are becoming widespread, reducing manual inspection workloads.
Pruning robot pilots are advancing, but detailed pruning still relies on people.

body: Tree trimmers and pruners prune, thin, shape, and remove dead branches from street, park, and residential trees. They address safety hazards involving power lines and buildings to protect the health and safety of urban greenery.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能用无人机巡检出枯枝和隐患，但「这根枝该不该锯、往哪边倒」的判断，还得靠挂在树上的师傅。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年布置员在岗约 6.01 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.21 万人，净增约 0.20 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.74 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.04 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代树木修剪工：修剪是典型的高空现场作业，爬树、下锯、控制倒向全靠人的协调和经验，机器人试点只覆盖了极少量简单场景。AI 能帮的是无人机巡检、排班管理和隐患台账，把「修哪里」找得更准，但「怎么修」仍靠人手。
ai_s2_accel: 无人机巡检枯枝与病害
ai_s3_list: 下锯判断：锯哪根、往哪倒算得准。
高空协调：爬树与车斗作业稳。
树木知识：树种、季节与修剪时机。
隐患识别：线与建筑的安全距离。
应急处置：断枝、卡锯的现场处理。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明树木修剪是「中高曝光」的户外作业：核心动作在高空和现场靠人手完成，AI 只能在巡检、排班、台账上帮忙，修剪本身短时间替代不了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光也别大意：无人机巡检已经在抢「找隐患」的活。往大树修剪、带电作业这些高风险高门槛方向专精，把持证和口碑做起来，你会比普通修剪工值钱得多。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想入行的年轻人先把身体练好，不恐高是前提；学园林绿化专业或跟班学徒都行，重点是考高空作业证和把安全习惯刻进肌肉记忆。
往大树修剪和带电作业专精，考相关资质；学会用无人机巡检和树木管理 App，一个人能管更多片区，收入也会明显上台阶。
园林养护、绿化普工转修剪工有优势：补上爬树和电锯技能，考高空作业证；面试时强调不恐高、能吃苦、安全意识强。
修剪工难招难留，建议「持证补贴 + 安全装备到位 + 险情加班费」留人；用无人机巡检减轻巡查负担，把熟手集中到高风险作业上。

ai_s7_trends: 城市树木安全管理趋严，大树修剪与带电作业需求上升。
无人机巡检普及，人工巡查负担减轻。
修剪机器人试点推进，精细修剪仍靠人工。
